test_title: PYST 58: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The team will announce the winner tomorrow.

options.text: The team will announce tomorrow the winner.
The winner will announce tomorrow by the team.
The winner will be announced by the team tomorrow.
Tomorrow will be announced the winner by the team.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The team will announce the winner tomorrow."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the winner" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will announce" to "will be announced" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the team."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "tomorrow" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The winner will be announced by the team tomorrow."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The team will announce tomorrow the winner." – This is not in passive voice.
 
• **Option 2: **"The winner will announce tomorrow by the team." – Incorrect structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"Tomorrow will be announced the winner by the team." – Incorrect structure.
